turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why am I here, and why wasn't I called before my son's mark was changed?
I spoke with the vice principal before you came in.
Spoke to the vice principal about what, exactly? And did anyone speak to me?
She's backing me completely. Policy is policy, and it isn't up to you.
Which policy? Procedure 4.2 says a parent is contacted before any mark is entered.
So frankly, this meeting is a courtesy.
A courtesy. Then it won't cost you anything to show me what you have on Owen's essay.
